-- Declarations for add_name

-- Returns the last element of a non-empty list.
last_of(xs: List[str]) -> str =
  pre xs.len() > 0
  ex last_of(["a", "b"]) == "b"
  xs[xs.len() - 1].copy()

-- Appends a copy of s to the caller's list dst, editing it in place.
add_name(var dst: List[str], s: str) =
  post dst.len() >= 1
  post last_of(dst) == s
  dst.append(copy s)
